{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the presence of 'new' in customer_segment
print("Unique customer_segment values:", df['customer_segment'].unique())

# Check for 'paid_search' in channel
print("Unique channel values:", df['channel'].unique())

# Check if 'converted' is binary (0 or 1)
print("Unique values in converted:", df['converted'].unique())

# Check status for refunded orders
print("Count of refunded orders:", df[df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0])

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Count of customer_age == -1:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())"}
